scenes: He became the richest inmate in American history while holding a multi-billion dollar empire.
Changpeng Zhao started from humble beginnings, working at McDonald's in Vancouver flipping burgers.
In twenty thirteen, a poker game changed everything when a friend introduced him to Bitcoin over drinks.
He went all in. He sold his apartment in Shanghai for nine hundred thousand dollars to buy entirely into Bitcoin.
Bitcoin crashed shortly after. But Zhao did not panic. He stayed focused on building infrastructure.
By July twenty seventeen, he launched Bi-nance. It processed orders at lightning speed and completely dominated markets.
Within one hundred eighty days, Bi-nance became the largest crypto exchange on Earth, handling billions daily.
Regulators closed in fast. U S authorities investigated Bi-nance for severe anti-money laundering failures.
In November twenty twenty-three, C Z stepped down as C E O and pleaded guilty to federal compliance violations.
Bi-nance agreed to pay a staggering four point three billion dollars fine to the United States government.
In April twenty twenty-four, a federal judge in Seattle sentenced C Z to four months inside a federal prison.
He served his time at Lompoc low-security facility in California, trading luxury for a tiny cell.
Despite sitting behind bars, his massive net worth remained completely intact due to his equity.
Released in late twenty twenty-four, C Z remains barred from running Bi-nance directly but keeps massive influence.
He became the richest inmate in American history while holding a multi-billion dollar empire.
